mapper.select: SELECT b.branch_id AS branchId, b.branch_name AS branchName, b.address AS address, b.region_code AS regionCode, ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) AS revenueGrowth, SUM(p.claim_count) AS claimCount, CASE WHEN ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) < -10.0 AND SUM(p.claim_count) > 5 THEN '매출 급감 및 클레임 다수' WHEN ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) < -10.0 THEN '매출 10% 이상 감소' WHEN SUM(p.claim_count) > 5 THEN '클레임 다수 발생 (위험 임계치 초과)' ELSE '기타 위험' END AS riskReason FROM branches_51 b JOIN branch_performance_51 p ON b.branch_id = p.branch_id WHERE b.operating_status = 'OPERATING' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name, b.address, b.region_code HAVING ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) < -10.0 OR SUM(p.claim_count) > 5 ORDER BY revenueGrowth ASC, claimCount DESC
